From this vantage point, you will see enemy ships (Y and + ), and members of your own squadron (U, V, W and X). You want to fire at and destroy the dangerous intruders, but be careful not to shoot at your allies! 

Use the space bar to fire as soon as an asteroid or enemy ship appears. Your timing must be very good. You score 20 points if you hit an enemy. You lose 20 points if you destroy a friendly ship. You have two minutes to play.

180659.overview: A version of breakout where the blocks hide an alluring, and highly-pixillated picture of a female. Published by Bytemike Software and also in Stonysoft #0104, Stonysoft-PD #0519 and in Italy in Supplementi Sipe - sexy games (Maggio 1988).

184733.overview:
Uridium Plus & Paradroid: Competition Edition is a double games pack containing the following games:
Uridium Plus
Paradroid: Competition Edition
Both games were only released for compilation use and basically just add ons to the originals Uridium and Paradroid with new levels. The only small difference for both games is that you can land anytime in Uridium Plus instead of being told to and Paradroid: Competition Edition is faster. 

Uridium Plus was also better optimized for compatibility with the Commodore 128 running in C64 mode, as the original game had some issues.

186947.overview:
An ice hockey game where you can play for either the world cup or choose a practice match. World cup play can include up to 9 players. On the ice there are two teams that face each other and put the puck into the goal. The winner is whoever has managed to do this the most at the end of  90 seconds plus a possible overtime. You control one player at a time and you can recognize him by his jersey color. The computer will try to allow you control of the player closest to the puck.  
 
The Italian version named Hockey Pista changed the game description have the game be roller hockey and refers to the puck as a ball. It was published in International Games n.7 (luglio/agosto 1991).

187610.overview:
A Scramble style shooter by the mighty Zoltán Ujhelyi & Birkas Mace. A new generation of Super Scramble! 
 
On the threshold of the twenty-second century, extra-planetary conflicts are now an everyday occurrence and the demand for good pilots has no limit. But to master the sophisticated attack aircraft resulting from the evolution  of centuries of wars, more and more skilled pilots are needed, so the training required to become a skyfighter must be very hard and selective. After years of testing and training you have reached the final test: you will have to face the fearsome Red Route, where driving your helicopter will have you flying over the attack zone to destroy enemy missile bases and gas reserves to refuel your vehicle. The test is NOT a simulation and if you want to keep your position you will need to do well. Happy hunting!

Published in Italy as Heliscan in Hit Parade C64 n.51 (Dicembre 1990) and in New Special PlayGames n.35 (ottobre 1990).

192157.overview: Haunt House (called Haunted House on the title screen) is actually a homebrew clone of Haunted House for the Atari 2600. It was developed by Donnie Russell II and released as a public domain game. The year of the release is not known.

192164.overview: Harry: At New Zealand is a shooter with platform elements. It was developed by Ejlis using Chris Yates' Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit in 1994 and released into the public domain by Ermig Productions.

192291.overview: Hexdec is a an educational game that teaches and tests the player on converted hex to decimals and vice-versa. It was developed by Jim Butterfield and Steve Gutz and published by Commodore Educational Software in 1982.

192393.overview: Students develop good writing habits as they follow a step-by-step approach to writing successful book reports and essays. Recommended for Grades 7-12.

192433.overview: A Brain & Logic game something like Q-Bert. Colour the squares with the hammer while dodging the balls, that randomly turn green allowing you to smash them (like in Pacman). You can also transport to the top-left corner of the screen if surrounded by walking off the right-hand side.  published in 64 Tape Computing No. 03 (1984 / 08-09) and in Go Games n.13 (October 1986) as Hammer.

192579.overview:
The Happy Tutor is a typing game developed by Ed Cotta for the C64. It was published in 1982 by Pacific Coast Software. a serious typing program consisting of keyboard drill and sentence practice for the mature user. It would be beneficial to a beginning typist or someone who knows how to type but desires to increase his speed for efficient programming or word processing. 

Upon loading THE HAPPY TUTOR you are asked if you want instructions. If you answer "yes", Instructions for the keyboard practice and sentence practice are typed on the screen along with the sound of clicking keys. After the Instructions are given or if you answered "no" a menu appears. The menu consists of eight options: keyboard practice, sentence practice, load sentences, compose sentences, save sentences, directory, view sentences or add sentences.

193432.overview:
Game is short but Hard, Basic Run and Dodge all Hazards and Watch out for The Masked Guy and Friend, No Weapons, No Magic, just a Girl that has to try to survive and Escape, No Score, No Lives, Just Survive.

You only have 1 Life so Don't Die!!

193433.overview: Obviously this game could have been named Halloween 64. The goal of the game is is to lead Michael Myers to kill someone instead of you, the witch. This gets increasingly difficult. Nice music and good intro scenes.

193528.overview:
As the game opens, you begin play as a captive in the dungeon of the black-hearted hangman.  To escape, you must outwit your opponents in a challenging, fast-paced contest of skill and luck, 

Featuring 3 levels of computer opponents, thousands of puzzles, and an original musical theme. PLUS oversize graphics that allow across-the-room play. Great for parties or family get togethers. 

For 2-4 players

194572.overview: The Haunted House is a horror themed text adventure for the Commodore 64 developed by Joe Garrett and published in Loadstar #022

194583.overview: Haus-Party: Weihnachtsedition (translates to House-Party: Christmas Edition) is a German language selectable answers text adventure with a holiday theme. It was developed by Paradroid and Octapolis and published into the public domain by Channel 666 in 2000.

194665.overview:
The computer games collection Heroes by the software company Domark from 1990 was released on diskette and on two datasettes with the following games:

Barbarian II (Action adventure)
Licence to Kill (Action game for the equally named James Bond movie)
Star Wars (Domark) (Space game for the equally named movie)
The Running Man (Action game for the equally name Schwarzenegger movie)

195859.overview:
You are Special Inspector Francis who has been sent to Harboro, a small market town in England, where a murder has been committed and the suspect arrested. However, they are unable to convict him because of lack of evidence. Your job is to find the murder weapon. 
 
Also contained in the trilogy release of "Harboro, Lost in the Amazon and St. Jives"

199274.overview: Hoverjet is a simple shooter in which it's just you vs. a single opponent. However, you also have to knock out your opponent's targets as well, which makes the game a little more challenging. This game was developed by Michael Sedlezky and published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1991/10. It was also one of the first games hosted online on Q-Link for download by Compute!

199349.overview: Hunkly is a strange little public domain game inspired by Frogger. Instead of your typical frog, you play a strange little "man" with an abnormally large, crooked nose. The game's developer and year of release are not currently known. Hunkly was coded entirely in BASIC.

199351.overview: Hungry Hoodlum is a shooter that also has some resemblance to Pac-Man. The main difference is instead of collecting the various items around the screen, you have to destroy them. There are also enemies that you can destroy and who can also shoot back and kill you. The game has 8 levels in total. It was developed by Mr-Soft and published in Compute mit 1987/07. The main character of this game is a kind of ROBO droid that has to destroy all 42 energy crystals in a labyrinth. He is hindered by 5 monsters or droids. The crystals are destroyed by targeted shots. The monsters can also be shot down. Each crystal gives you 100 times level points. 200 times the level for each monster, and for each completed level you get 10,000 times the level points. If you are rammed or shot down by a monster, you lose one of your 5 lives.

199352.overview: High Gear is a simple overhead racing game developed by Nathan Butcher using Garry Kitchen's GameMaker. The year of release is not known.

199389.overview: It must be a nice day to go fishing because your pond is filled with danger everywhere! Not a good day to be a big fish in a little pond. Avoid the hooks but get the worm when you can! Has two player simultaneous competitive play.

200055.overview:
Hallax is a Breakout/Arkanoid clone with power ups for 1-2 players (not simultaneously) It was developed by Relxax Designs and released by Binary Zone under their public domain label.

It was also released commercially in the following...

•    Zzap!64 Megatape #37 (11/1992)
•    Commodore Format 1993/08 (Issue #35

As well as in the public domain again in:

•    Commodore Free #078

200056.overview: Hals und Beinbruch, which literally translates to "Break a Leg" is a German language 1-2 player downhill skiing game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Nikolas Bergerhoff and published by Markt & Technik in 64'er Sonderheft 30.

200418.overview: A basic version of the classic "Hangman" puzzle game for the C64.

201034.overview:
You live in a world full of magic, monsters, and maidens.

As a mercenary, or a hired sword as you’re known in this world, you never worry for coin as the rich and poor alike are always in need of your services. Well, usually that is.

Turns out you squandered all your coin on women and libations, not for the first time and most certainly not the last! But this time you met a seductive elf with long flowing white hair that captured your interests, and although you hate to admit it, perhaps your heart?

However she’s nowhere to be found and thus yet another quest for adventure awaits!

201124.overview: A Viking themed, Italian language, text adventure (with graphics) created by Alessandro Zanello and published in Next Strategy n.09 (06/1986). It was the 2nd game in a trilogy including the original Haakon: Naufragio nel Mare del Nord and followed by Haakon: Haakon ed i Fuorilegge.

201439.overview: Hyper Space Warrior is a side scrolling shooter developed by Emmanuel Fontaigo of Legendary Designs and published and released in 1995. It was released as part of Loadstar #127. A wild, side-scrolling space shoot-em-up. Avoid everything that moves and shoots. Pick up anything that looks valuable. Blast everything but NOT blindly. Shoot the shimmering attack vessels when they are close enough to snatch its payload, which will increase your weapon power. Accumulate power early so you can survive the later rounds. Time your travels through force field doors, if you don't you're toast. Star fields will allow you to reverse direction.

203677.overview:
Not to be confused with Thalamus' Heatseeker (one word), which is a platformer. Heat Seeker is a 1985 shooter for 1 or 2 players (alternating turns) .

It was developed by Jeff Wolverton and released in the following:

•   COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1985/03 (Issue #21)
•   Best of COMPUTE! & Gazette
•   Super VIC & C64 A2-N07 (July/August 1985)

206719.overview: An educational quiz created in English and Dutch where you learn the Geography of Europe.

207350.overview: Despite its name, this has nothing to do with the music genre, rather it's a platform puzzle game much in the same style as A*bert, but played in a flat surface. Hip Hop was developed by Tony Brantner and published as a type-in listing in RUN 1992/01-02.

210365.overview: An update to the Finnish Asteroid clone published originally in 1985. It translates the Finnish to English and contains updated graphics.

210658.overview:
RESCUE THE UNIVERSE BY DESTROYING MOST OF IT!

Code : Mika "Misfit" Keränen

Music : 8-bits high

Choose any of the 3 Rad pilots and help save the whole Universe. Hi-Energy, Fast action game play..

213669.overview: Hanger 14 is a sci-fi themed clone of the arcade game Hunchback for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Justin Luton and published in Ahoy! 1987/01 (Issue #37).

215458.overview: A strategy hacking\domination game in English and German created for the Forum64 Game Competition 2016: Strategy.  Choose your homeland, conquer your local network and expand your influence and control. Random events impact gameplay and you will need to race to get the best networks.

215459.overview:
The goal of the puzzle is to move the entire stack to another rod, following the following simple rules:

- Only one disk can be transferred at a time.

- Each move involves removing the top disk from one stack and placing it on another pile or on an empty bar.

-You can not place a larger disk on a smaller disk.

215460.overview:
A German language text adventure with graphics for medium to low level challenge. Move in mystic labyrinths, search hidden caves, fight dragons and overcome the pernicious swamp beast and deadly mists in this fantasy adventure by Daniel Akik, released by Dat Houscps Software in 1990. Poor Harak's home village was invaded by the evil sorcerer Kart Offel. This evil sorcerer dwells, as befits a wizard, in a mage tower beyond the great mountains. Crossing it is the first obstacle the young hero faces. But even if this hurdle has been overcome, he unfortunately cannot compete with Kart Offel. The wizard is just too powerful. A snap of your fingers and Harak would be transformed into a toadstool...

And why should Harak Iri put all the stress on himself? Simple, stupid Kart Offel stole his home computer! If that's not reason enough...

So the warrior needs a little help, and there's really only one choice. Kart Offel's biggest enemy is his brother Pant Offel. If you find this, you might be able to put a stop to the magician's work.

215462.overview: An unofficial update to the original Hardball! game that provide access to selectable teams and some additional stat updates. Like the original, is is a baseball action game for one or two players. You can throw a variety of pitches from fast balls to curveballs, steal bases, select team members, and substitute players as the game is played.

215463.overview: Per the title page of the version released in GO64! 2005/10, this is "A French text adventure game. Made in 1988 and written by Lee." It is a selectable answers game.

215464.overview: Hodge Podge is an educational - vocabulary/language game created by Leonard Bertoni & Rich Scocchera and released in 1984. Obviously intended for very young children, simply press any letter or number on the keyboard for the corresponding animation/picture.

215465.overview: A strategy war game for one to six players created by Kenneth Haydon and released to the public domain in 1985.

215466.overview:
A dutch language text adventure game created by John Vanderaart and released for the C64 in 1985. An expanded version would be released for the PC a few years later.  You play an unnamed adventurer who gets captured by the (former) vampire Dr. A. Cula. You got knocked out and regain consciousness in a broom closet of a hotel. There is a curse on the hotel, however, so you cannot leave. As Dr. Cula appears to be up to no good, your goal is to kill Dr. Cula and lift the curse.  
 
The game is text only, but it has some helpful displays. In the upper left corner of the screen, you see a small map of all screens you have discovered for each floor of the hotel. In the upper right corner, all visible exits are displayed, as well as an index if there is a portable object.
The game runs in real-time and has a time limit to complete. A constantly running counter is displayed on screen. If the timer is below a certain number, Dr. Cula will search the hotel for you.

215467.overview: This was a text adventure that listed for $69.95 and purported to allow your Commodore 64 to hypnotize you. The regression techniques used by The Hypnotist are based on the neural linguistic patterns used by world-famous medical hypnotist Milton H. Erikson, M.D.  These patters are very subtle, almost undetectable to the nonprofessional. You will barely realize the effects until you begin to recall the past or project yourself into your own future. Hypnosis and trance induction is achieved by strobing at the specific frequency require to bring on a trance. It claimed to be able to induce super learning and other strange mental states as part of the overall game and was released by Psycom Software International in 1983.

215468.overview: Billed as a contemporary fantasy it was a short adventure written in 2 parts by the Infocom tester, Tom Bek in 1986. It was rediscovered as source in late 2019. It shares many of the resources as Leather Goddesses of Phobos. While playing the adventure you get the idea that it was put together to test a couple of additions to the parser prior to the release of that version of Z-code.

215480.overview: Work to reveal the hidden pictures in this not-quite-a-game as much as it is an excuse to show the pictures off. Only slightly better than trying to watch a scrambled channel you didn't subscribe to on cable at the time.

215508.overview: You play as a helicopter pilot and must traverse a dangerous Alien underground fortress on Earth to find the construction blue prints which are saved on a floppy disk. Mutant martians from outerspace attacking the earth and built a giant underground fortress. The martian buttheads saved their construction blue prints to a floppy disk you must find. An air force special helicopter unit h order to get this disk you've got five machines and enough fuel to start this dangerous operation all hope rests on your skills and courage. Good luck soldier!

216466.overview: A one player motorcycle racing game depicting the Paris-Dakar race created in 1984 and published in Commodore Club N°04 / a.k.a. "The Race of Paris-Dakar".

216616.overview:
Hugohunt is a maze collect 'em up developed by Angelsoft (not to be confused with the US based company of the same name that developed games in the 1980s, but a modern German based developer). The game was released into the public domain in 2015.

The game is actually a conversion of an old Atari 8-Bit game of the same name.

218261.overview:
A single-screen style (not scrolling) platformer created by Gerrit Knoef for one or two simultaneous players and published in Input 64 1987/03. If you like hacking pits for others... 

... is definitely a friend of the Happy  Hacker. It is well known that malicious joy should be the purest joy, but who is so evil and lets his friends stumble into the self-made trap? But when it comes to monsters, things look very different. This game consists of a total of 40 levels, which are divided into two areas. The first twenty levels can be selected as the LEVEL«- EASY option in the start menu. Beginners should first practice in this position before playing the next 20 levels: these are reached with LEVEL 4-HARD. In order to get from one level to the next, it is important to render harmless all the monsters that are stalking you. First you have to catch a monster by setting a trap for it. Just hack a hole with the pick-axe; now a little patience and waited until a monster is trapped. When the time comes, little remains to be done, and the monster is eliminated. Hurried to the trap and swung the pick-axe! One, two, three — get to the next critter! Of course, the sack of gold is not forgotten, because 500 points are no small matter, but a further rung on the way to the leader board. Experienced monster hunters get a bonus before they go to the next level. However, this is only possible if you don't dawdle beforehand. But you'll soon find out. 

If there are two players, they can play one after the other or together. The interaction offers the possibility to trick the other players. Simply select COOPERATE «- YES! All other questions are quickly clarified during the first audition.

218263.overview:
Jagten På Bubbers Badekar (Danish for Hunt for Bubber's Bathtub) is a weird little Euro-style arcade adventure from Denmark in which you have to find the character's bathtub, which was stolen. The game was developed by Ole Mogensen & Michael Lauridsen and published by Interactivision in 1991.

An unofficial English translation with the English title of Hunt for Bubber's Bathtub was released by the cracking group Laxity in 2013.

218536.overview:
Hat Trick 2020 (also known as Hat Trick: Four Player Mod and Hat Trick Extended) is a hacked version of Pacific Dataworks International's official C64 conversion of the arcade game of the same name. This hack adds the ability for up to four players to play, in teams of two, as opposed to two players only. This extended version hack was done by Barfly and released into the public domain on February 21, 2020.

Adding the extra players basically turns the game into an unofficial version of Team Hat Trick, which was a 4 player version released in arcade in 1985.

219113.overview:
Harvest fruit as fast possible to score points and prevent them leaving the top of the screen. Each time a fruit leaves the screen the row is cleared but a life is lost.

Matching fruits can be harvested in pairs horizontally, vertically, or diagonally by selecting them with the cursor and pressing fire.
However, they can only be cleared if they are either next to each other or there is clear space between them. 
After 8 pairs are cleared, the level (and speed) increases.

Clearing an entire row of fruit will move all fruit above it down one row.

219159.overview: A side-scrolling submarine themed shoot em up for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Igor Errazkin using Jonathan Well's side-scrolling mod of the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit, and published in 2016 by TND.

219202.overview: A single player slalom game where you must avoid snow bunnies, trees, rocks and the inevitable abominable snowman while you race down the slopes and between the flags. Game created by Sonny Top aka Bamse and released in 1990.

219878.overview: You're a "fraidy cat" who happens to be scared of mice, so the mice chase you around a maze just like the ghosts do in Pac Man.  And your goal is to clear the screen of cat food "pellets" so that you can advance to the next screen.  And when you run into the catnip pouches placed here and there, this emboldens the cat for a brief time so that he can devour the mice who are chasing him (he takes on a "wild cat" form).

417916.overview:
Hot-Food (also known in Italy as Dentiera) is a clone of the old Atari 2600 game, Fast Food for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Volker Wiewer and published in the following:

- 64'er Sonderheft 1985/03
- Game 2000 N°10 (Gennaio 1986)

The game itself also plays a rendition of the Star Wars theme while the game is being played.

417977.overview:
A selectable answers adventure created by Fred S. Randall (lord land serf) and released in 1985 by CW Communications, Inc./RUN in the RUN Gamepack Disk, and then later in Binary Zone PD. 

Not a bad early RPG, for one written in BASIC. Most notable is the use of bizarre enemy names such as Iron Claw, Mugwumpus, Blue Smurf, Purple Pox, Megadonkey, Moon Devil, Slime Hulk, Pulverizer, Mad Hacker, Bystander, and even Programmer who appears towards the end.

417987.overview: Haunted Inn is a single-screen platform game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Uwe Heinrich and published in both Computronic 1987/09-10, as well as ,Tiger-Crew-Disk #44

418232.overview: A preview of a shooter being created. You start at midpoint and must shoot above and below before any aliens make it to the line across the middle of the screen.

419250.overview:
Horse Guard (also spelled as a single word) is a clone of the old Atari 2600 game Stampede. It was developed by A. Knipschild and published in Compute mit 1984/42 (10.10.1984).

Round up the horses to increase your cash.

419404.overview:
Herisferix is a game which was originally written using the Shoot Em Up Construction Kit. It was imported into the SEUCK Redux framework and features some pretty cool enhancements, such as enemy firing intelligence, some power ups and no SEUCK slowdown syndrome. The game also features a new score panel and front end. The game was enhanced and submitted by special request of the game author, Pinov Vox, himself. This game was exclusively released on Zzap! 64 Micro Action issue 14's digital covermount. The game is also available to download and play online.


Instructions:

Your home base has been attacked by an evil alien empire. Your mission is to fly your space fighter through all five zones, fight away the alien interceptors and defeat their Empire. Locate the last boss and then shut it down by blasting at the gate. The aliens will be waiting to do battle against you and some alien interceptors will aim directly for your ship before firing lasers. 

There are blue enemy ships parked on board the alien base. You can destroy those by flying over them. Pick up green pods for a temporary shield also collect pink pods for long range firing, orange pods will give you a two-way firing power up. Also shoot at the special energy. This will arm your space fighter with a smart bomb. Spacebar/fire joy port 1 will activate it and will destroy all evil aliens on sight. You can only activate smart bombs when the border is red. If an alien kills you, any power up in your possession will  be lost and your space fighter will be restored to its default. 

Can you complete all five zones, and defeat the evil alien Empire, or will there be nothing left of you? 

Good luck pilot!

Game design and graphics: Pinov Vox/Vox Videogame (using S.E.U.C.K)

Redux Code and enhancements: Martin Piper and TND Games

Music: Pinov Vox


(C)2023 Vox Video Game in co-op with The New Dimension.

Like with all  TND Games featured on itch.io. This production is non-commercial  software. You are welcome to copy this production, or use it on your web site - providing that you do not sell any part of this release commercially in physical  or digital form without permission from the author.

420287.overview:
100: Hack the System (also known as Hack the System) is an education math game with puzzle elements similar in some ways to Mastermind, but with addition. You complete against the AI. The goal is to be the first to reach a sum of 100, hence the name of the game. 

The game was developed by B. Spartalis and published in PIXEL Junior #2 (01/1988).

420288.overview: Habitat is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) developed by LucasArts. It is the first attempt at a large-scale commercial virtual community that was graphic based. Initially created in 1985 by Randy Farmer, Chip Morningstar, Aric Wilmunder and Janet Hunter the game was made available as a beta test in 1986 by Quantum Link, an online service for the Commodore 64 computer and the corporate progenitor to AOL. Both Farmer and Morningstar were given a First Penguin Award at the 2001 Game Developers Choice Awards for their innovative work on Habitat. As a graphical MUD[7] it is considered a forerunner of modern MMORPGs unlike other online communities of the time (i.e. MUDs and massively multiplayer onlines with text-based interfaces). Habitat had a GUI and large user base of consumer-oriented users, and those elements in particular have made Habitat a much-cited project and acknowledged benchmark for the design of today's online communities that incorporate accelerated 3D computer graphics and immersive elements into their environments.

422934.overview: You entered a mansion, The House of Mr Chuf. A good old magician who passed away several years ago. You are on holiday, and booked a room in the mansion, unaware that it is haunted by evil spirits. Every single household object and toys have been posessed. For some odd reason the objects are armed with bullets, which were taken from Mr Chuf's draw. You find spare bullets, and pick up a rife and set out to turn your holiday nightmare into an adventure. Shoot at those toys and other objects, to kill the evil spirits. May the house of Mr Chuf be ghost free.

424228.overview: A game in which you need to grab all the circular colours to move on to the next level! Cozy one button action puzzler, 20 levels. Some are really tricky. Inspired by one button bob and ns-tower (1997). Coded in kickassembler in the c64 game engine cry64engine (chludens). The levels were designed according to the japanese r-type method: create a level, if you have to make 10 attempts, then the level comes into the game. Try to catch all pixel stars, circles. Try to not use too many lives to finish the game!.

424237.overview:
The Tenebra guy is in trouble again! After going through all those dark dungeons and crypts he has found himself in the middle of an increasing horde of monsters who think he is their dinner. Help him fend them off, level up and gain more abilities in the process, and blast them all to hell! Can be played with 2 joysticks or as a cooperative 2 player game. 

This is a "coffee-break" game. The music is by an unknown composer.

424336.overview:
Superb tribute to classic Mastertronic games like Action Biker and The Last V8 with this brand-new C64 release HAMMER DOWN!  Get on your bike and carefully negotiate the tricky map collect all the items and bonuses scattered around the town.  If you feel the need for speed then just put the HAMMER DOWN! 
 
The game was released as part of a bonus item for the Commodore C64 Collector's guide to Mastertronic.

425417.overview: A single player puzzle game created by Lobo & Daniel Hotop for the 2020 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition. Use joystick in port 2 to move the cursor. Hold fire and move in a direction to move a piece, cyan pieces can be moved. Pink ones can't. Hold fire on the green water sources to start the water flow. Put out all the fires to complete the level. Beware the move count though. Grey boxes with pink lines are only weak on the side with the line.

425467.overview:
A card game in 4KB as a Craptastic 2022 competition entry from TWAiN PAiN Games. Welcome to HARD FOAM, a card game packed into only 4KB for the Commodore 64. Featuring 32 cards and just under 20 unique effects, soundfx and lovely PETSCII graphics.

Put your monsters on the table and defeat your opponent. Cast spells to enhance your own or attack those that oppose you.

425468.overview: Head Hunter is a compact, simple run & gun style platformer and the aim is to collect all the gems to progress to the next level, whilst avoiding or destroying the angry falling heads.

443117.overview: There are platforms, but you cannot jump, only use transporters and fall. Can you figure out how to get your crafty cat to all the diamonds? Is this even a platformer if you cannot jump?  It's a good mixture of collect 'em up and brainware, since you'll need a strategy to pick up all the goodies.

443946.overview:
Framed for a crime he did not commit, 64-K must spend the rest of his life in the prison ship HARHARAGON, the most secure prison ship in the galaxy. All because the Grand Galactic King was unhappy his daughter Nico had fallen for such a lowly solider of the realm.
 
YOUR ONLY HOPE NOW IS TO ESCAPE.

444260.overview: A game that that looks to be inspired by Huck and Jim's Journey Down the Mississippi River in the Novel, The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn by Mark Twain. Development started back in 1987, but after a break of 35 years Frank finished coding the game in 2024. Use the joystick in Port 2 to control your player on a log. Move up/down and left/right to pick up objects from the water and collect points. Avoid contact with wild ducks, crocodiles and other dangerous animals. There are 10 levels with a "final boss" after which it's over. I think both are motivating.

444273.overview:
The key is invisibly hidden somewhere on the screen. Walk over the spot to find it. Then unlock the gate to get to the exit. You start with 150 energy 'steps'.

 Each move uses 1 energy. Dots add 10 energy. Game ends if energy goes below zero. There are 12 challenging levels!

446597.overview: Heng: HiRes Engine (also known as just Heng) is an unreleased role-playing game for the Commodore 64 that was supposed to pay homage to the first game in Sid Meier's Civilization franchise. However, the game was never finished and the prototype version was released in 2009. It was developed by Martin "enthusi" Wendt.

446680.overview: This game is a port of the 1973 BASIC game 'Hammurabi' to C. It has been enhanced with some graphics and music. In this game you impersonate Hammurabi, the administrator of Sumeria.

448374.overview: Sort the balls in the tubes. To finish a level the tubes have to be filled to the top with only identically colored balls or be empty. Use the letter keys to pick a ball and place it into another tube. You can also put the ball back  into the same tube. When moving a ball to another tube you can only drop it on top of an equally colored ball or into an empty tube. Invalid moves are blocked and indicated by a flashing border. There is not time or retry limit. Progress is saved after solving a level.

451333.overview: A 1989 compilation cartridge featuring one Parker Brothers game and three Activision games: Frogger, River Raid, Decathlon and Beamrider. It was released by HES Australia.

452187.overview:
This is a brilliant and early look at what could have been an amazing space shooter! SM magazine issue 7/89 had a short news feature that stated that Mario van Zeist and X-ample were hired to make games for Digital Marketing, followed by some information on both Hydrogenese and Bamboo. However, the BWB link was a red herring, and it was Joachim Fraeder who confirmed that it was X-Ample behind the game. Coder was Helge Kozielek, with graphics by Michael Detert and Thomas Heinrich. The sprites and backgrounds we later recycled and used in Parsec.
 
A shoot’em up similar to Armalyte or Menace and it was about four “heroes” with different strengths and weaknesses. The player could choose between these heroes and the task was to “clean up” the weapon systems of a space ship. The player was also supposed to also be able to remote control cleaning robots.

452662.overview:
Color Water Sort Basic (also known as Heustack Clone) is extactly that, a clone of the C64 game Huestack (which was also released in 2024), but done entirely in BASIC.

It was developed by Steveboy for the scene group Blazon, and released into the public domain on August 9, 2024.

453439.overview: You control Herra47's movements with the joystick in port 2 and by inputting commands into a text parser.

453527.overview:
Harrier Strike was to be a single-player horizontally scrolling shooter for the C64. It was developed by Reflective Designs, and set to be published by Players Software, but ended up getting cancelled.

It was programmed by Duncan Scott Kershaw with graphics by Arless Kershaw

The game bares so resemblance to The game Steel Eagle, which was developed by the same team, and released the same year (also by Players)

Apparently, it was to be a spiritual sequel to Steel Eagle.

454621.overview:
HITOKIRI is a new nerve-raking, mind-boggling puzzle game for the Commodore 64.

You have been betrayed. Your clan, disbanded. Your family, killed. You were once a proud samurai: now you must walk the path of the ronin and seek vengeance upon those who wronged you.

Will you walk the path of bushido, or will you exact terrible punishment?

Walk around the levels disguised as a monk, plan your assassinations, and touch the jizo statues to reveal your true nature and kill the samurai. But beware: as soon as you unsheate your katana, the metsuke will start to chase you!

- Exciting old school gameplay inspired by classics such as Eggerman/Lolo

- Feudal japanese atmospheric gameplay inspired by the works of Koike, Kojima, Inoue and Yoshikawa
- More than 20 levels (there are several secret ones: can you find them?)

- Escape the metsuke, kill the samurai, avoid guard dogs and don't step on spikes!

- Meditative japanese-folk soundtrack

- Evocative sound effects of clashing swords, gurgling blood, and switching levers (are those a thing?)

- Collect extra lives, and money to raise your score

- Karma system: killing civilians may seem easier, but what about your honor?

- Difficulty settings: tailor the game experience to your liking

- Permanent blood stains across the level (in a puzzle game! That's a first!)

- Race against time, or set the game without limits for a more casual experience

- Real haiku will make you feel very zen (or very bloodthirsty)

- 4 different endings will reward your different choices

- Reach true illumination through vengeance, and permanently unlock a new challenging real-time game mode!

The game is controlled through WASD keys and spacebar on the keyboard, or by joystick in port 2

456009.overview:
The Horse is a sliding tile puzzle game in which you must put together/assemble a monochromatic picture of a horse (hence the game's name)

The game was developed by Thomas Canfield and published in Loadstar #066.

You can change the background and horse color, but the game remains in just two colors.

456217.overview:
Who likes a good spy thriller? Well, now's your chance. You're involved in a ultimate car chase in which you are to hunt down Agent 005. Why? Well, let's just say that he's picnched your favourite ham sandwich, served by your favourite waitress at the counter. You get really annoyed and set off on a chase to have it back.  The trouble is, there's a mass of gangsters driving through the cities, having a war against you. Shoot at those bad guys and find Agent 005 - then blast him down. Go, go, go superspy - get your ham sarnie back before Agent 005 eats it. :o))

Developed by Roberto Ricioppo, Richard Bayliss, and Jonathan Wells using Sideways SEUCK, and released in 2011.

456597.overview:
Your task in The Haunted Castle is fairly simple: avoid the ghosts while searching the castle for three treasures. It sounds easy, but it isn't. First of all, the castle has over 1000 rooms (1100 to be exact) spread over 11 levels (100 рег level). Second, the ghosts open and close the doors leading from each room at will, and you have no key with which to unlock them when they are closed. If a ghost catches you, it will steal a treasure and place it somewhere else in the castle. Should a ghost catch you without a treasure, the game will end.

Published in Ahoy! issue January 1986 (Issue #25).

457191.overview:
Hey, Taxi! was an entry in the 2025 BASIC 10Liner competition (it placed 4th out of 32 entries in the PUR-80 category).

 It is for the Commodore 64, and was developed by Roman Werner. The game is essentially an homage to the 1984 C64 classic, Space Taxi.

From BASIC 10Liner itch.io page:

"Life is hard and money short in the moon orbit. Not many customers here - at all. All the more I need to provide a fast and excellent service with my space cab to get an additional tip now and then. The old lady is a bit rusty but nothing that can't be covered with a little coat of yellow paint. I should check the left nozzle though - it rattles a bit when I give full throttle. But let's not talk to the stars - the next customer is waiting. Cheers!"


Task and Goal

=============

Carefully manoeuvre your space cab to the next platform where you see a new waiting customer. Gentle landing provided you get paid 10$ as soon as you have touched solid ground. But don't flambé your guest with your cab's thrust and watch the fuel meter to have enough rocket fuel left for the landing phase. You may choose to land on a platform in between to refill your tank on the way. Good luck! The game is won when you earned more 100$ (or more).


Control:

========

Joystick in Port 2

Joystick left:  Activate right thrust to glide to the left

Joystick right: Activate left thrust to glide to the right

Joystick up or fire button: Activate both engines to raise faster

459058.overview:
A philosophical journey through the existential void of modern life... with pixels.

Hipstercade explores life's greatest questions - mainly about patience and the crushing weight of routine. Experience the beautiful meaninglessness of contemporary existence: act, repeat, question your choices, repeat again. Get inspired by quotes from history's most celebrated free-thinkers. Unlock hidden hipster artifacts that validate your superior taste.

Hipstercade is so authentically underground, you've probably never heard of it. This game is essential for every aspiring hipster - though the truly enlightened ones have obviously been playing it ironically since before you even considered growing that moustache.

Featuring original retro aesthetics from the golden age of 8-bit gaming, served with the perfect amount of sarcasm and existential dread. Success requires patience, a steady hand, quick reflexes, and most importantly, a deep understanding of the complex hipster psyche.

459422.overview: 8 in the Árok 2025 Game Dev competition

459432.overview: Herra 47, a man recently facing the harsh reality of unemployment, finds himself in a predicament. The annual Midsummer Festival is fast approaching.

459692.overview:
This game is a homage to H.E.R.O. from John Van Ryzin, published by Activision in 1984.

This version contains 20 completely new levels.

The game runs perfectly on both PAL and NTSC models of the Commodore 64.

Introduction
The hardworking miners of Mount Leone have been locked in the cave system through sudden volcanic activities.

Our hero Roderick Hero now starts for the search of the missing persons with his special equipment (backpack helicopter, integrated helmet laser and dynamite).

After a successful rescue, the player reaches the next level.

Power
The energy is filled up at the start of every level. When the full energy is used up, the player loses a life and starts again at the beginning of the level.

Dynamite
The pits spread far vertically and horizontally into the interior of the mountain. Sometimes walls, which Rod needs to blow away with dynamite, block the way. At the beginning of every level, the player gets 6 sticks of dynamite. After the ignition, Rod must move away fast or else he will lose a life.

Laser beam
The player can use the laser to kill the enemies. The laser can also be used in place of dymanite to evaporate a wall, though this method takes about 10 seconds.

Enemies
In the pits lurk different creatures such as spiders, bats, poisonous moths or snakes. At some rivers, an invincible, hungry sea monster appears, constantly following our hero. Some walls that contain magma sediments glow red and must not be touched.

Lanterns
Lanterns light the dark pits. A shot or a touch is enough and the light goes out forever.

Raft
A heat resistent raft can be used at some places to cross the magma river

460593.overview: The player's task is to reach the delicious milk while avoiding contact with hostile creatures and all elements of the environment. Generally, there is only one board in the game, the difficulty of which increases with each subsequent drink of milk through the appearance of additional obstacles and an increase in the speed of the creatures. It should also be remembered that milk can be drunk if it does not come into contact with an enemy creature.

462473.overview: HipoFruta. This is a very addictive and fun platform game in which you play as a friendly hippopotamus and try to overcome all kinds of obstacles.

462731.overview: hungry frog! move you fast in this caotic arcade game!

464205.overview:
Hell Racer is a pseudo 3d-shooter for the Commodore 64. It is based on the Commodore Plus4/C16 game Zagan Warrior (which in turn also borrows a bit from the ZX Spectrum classic, Death Chase)
It was developed and released by Technische Maschinenfabrik (which translates to Technical Machine Factory) in 2011, with an updated version released the following year.

469138.overview: This game is an adaptation of the semi-graphic Italian adventure 'Murray Shannon: L'Orrore di Goldmine City' by Bonaventura Di Bello. It was originally written using The Quill and Illustrator and published by Edizioni Hobby S.r.l. on the cover tape of 'Explorer', no. 8, June 1987 for the Commodore 64 and MSX.

469461.overview: The Hopper Devils is a single player shooter developed by Gaetano Chiummo using the Shoot 'em UP Construction Kit, and published by Sea Software in 1990.

470747.overview: Hopper Rabbit aka HR, is a game inspired by the PC game of the same name. It was prepared for Commodore 64 in 2024 using the basic language.

473626.overview: Hex64 is a clean, minimalist strategy puzzle game built entirely in Commodore 64 BASIC!

474150.overview:
The Zzyaxians want to destroy Earth but don't want to appear near the planet as the chances of success are slim. They have decided that they will Hyper-Space near Pluto and create a surprise attack. Problem for them is that while they are zooming towards our Solar System, we have detected them arriving and where their re-entry point will be. Quickly a Hellgate has been built surrounding the re-entry point and it is up to you to control four laser heads on the walls of the gate and blast anything that appears over 20 levels (the first eight can be selected). When all aliens are destroyed it's onto the next wave of Zzyaxians. Occasionally some goats will appear and run across the gate, if they make it without being killed you get bonus points.

The laser heads can only move along the wall and fire inwards across the gate. The four heads are split into two, yellow and purple. You control the yellow heads and when you move one the purple head opposite moves in tandem. Moving your joystick in one direction moves one ship around the walls and moving in another direction moves the other head. The aliens appear in the centre of the gate and move towards the walls, and when they reach it, they move along it until they touch a laser head. Any laser head being touched makes them all explode but destroys anything else in the gate. You lose one of four lives and when you lose them all it is game over.

Hellgate is a shoot-em-up with the whole game played on one screen. You and a friend can play and you each take it in turns when a life is lost. It is a sequel to Laser Zone.

474446.overview: Hang the DJ is a game that I first envisioned in 1995, and made as a test and learning objective for improving my programming skills. Later in 2024, seeing that the Mega 65 platform needed some exclusive titles, I reimagined Hang the DJ into a Mega 65 game. With the C 64 Ultimate hitting the streets, I have ported the Mega 65 game to C64, and used the less capabilities of the C64 - to improve on the game. Thats what the C64U is for ;)

478316.overview: Sixteen live balls on a machine with eight sprites. All of them moving, all of them colliding.

480649.overview: A Hollow Knight demake — for a real breadbin C64, written from scratch.

481409.overview: Hot! Potato is my first assembly language game for the Commodore 64.  It was entirely hand coded in Turbo Macro Pro - no IDE and absolutely no AI

482039.overview: Happy Camper is a campsite logic puzzle for the Commodore 64. Place each two-square campervan so the row and column clues add up, no two vans touch—even diagonally—and every van is paired with exactly one fire.

482079.overview:
Haiku The Duel is ported from Mega65 to C64 using XC-BASIC. 

The haiku is not a poem — it’s a breath. A moment. A whisper. And this game? It’s a whole universe of breaths

You are competing against the computer or a friend in making the ultimate and best HAIKU.

Prepare to show your stunt haiku powers and possibly feel a surge of energy and inspiration while doing so.

Good luck - my HAIKU friend.

482080.overview: HORSE RACE CHAMPIONS! brings the excitement of horse racing to your Commodore 64!

482207.overview: Hacker is a puzzle game for the Commodore 64.

482277.overview: The enemy has hidden 6 secret outposts on an 8x8 battlefield. You have hidden 6 of your own. Send your bombers over enemy territory, drop your bombs and wipe out every enemy outpost before the enemy bombers wipe out yours!

482569.overview: You must survive three nights of assault. By day you rest, mend and tend the hurt. There is no re-supply: your stock must last all three nights. Keep an eye on your 'dread' meter: it rises with silence, darkness, damage and death, and at high levels can warp your perceptions and paralyse you.

482752.overview: Heroes of Sokoban is a puzzle game made with PuzzleScript by Jonah Ostroff.

482779.overview: The wizard must collect all the stars to conjure away the eerie creatures: werewolves, witches, ghosts, and vampires. Can you help him? Of course you can!

482788.overview: HELICOPTER RESCUE 12! is an exciting Commodore 64 rescue game featuring 12 challenging missions. Fly your helicopter through mountains, storms, wildfires and dangerous seas. Rescue people, avoid obstacles and manage your fuel. Each mission becomes more difficult. Can you complete all 12 rescues and become the ultimate rescue pilot?

482829.overview: This game is a Commodore 64 version of the Chinese sliding block puzzle "Huarong Road". Slide the pieces of the opposing army to allow Cao Cao (the largest piece) to exit the board. This game features 6 possible initial patterns to solve. Try and solve them in the lowest amount of moves possible.
